test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The people will make him the leader.

options.text: He had been made the leader by people.
He will be made the leader by the people.
He was made leader by the people.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• *​*The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.
 
• The usage of a helping verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.<
